name: Minaxi Textiles Limited
about: Minaxi Textiles Limited engages in weaving, manufacturing, and selling cotton and cotton mixture fabrics in India. It offers suiting lycra fabric, cotton quilts, broken twill fabric, and satin fabric. The company is also involved in weaving of synthetic grey cloth of suiting and shirting; and the supply of uniform to government and semi-government departments. In addition, it offers suiting products, such as fancy suiting fabrics. Minaxi Textiles Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.
